newsitem.title: USA: Amgen Epogen, Neupogen sales rise in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Amgen Epogen, Neupogen sales rise in Q1.

text.p: Amgen Inc said the 12 percent overall increase in sales in the first quarter, reflect a 19 percent increase in worldwide sales of its Epogen red-blood cell boosting agent and a five percent increase in sales of Neupogen, which boosts white blood cell count.
Epogen sales in the quarter totalled $292 million and Neupogen sales rose to $244 million.

The growth rate of both products slowed from the fourth quarter, when Epogen sales rose 22 percent and Neupogen 10 percent. Amgen said the slower sales growth of Neupogen reflected unfavorable European currency exchange rates.
